from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
owners = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-owner-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["owners"]
before = OUT / "core-models-before-public-metadata.json"
entries = []
for owner in owners:
    module = owner["path"].removeprefix("backend/").removesuffix(".py").replace("/", ".")
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / ".tmp/core_models_snapshot.py"), "verify-owner", module], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=False)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (module, result.stdout, result.stderr)
    summary = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert summary["matches_before"] and summary["compile_errors"] == 0
    entries.append(summary)
document = {"all_13_owner_first_entries_match_public_baseline": True, "actual_full_metadata_comparison_per_entry": True, "baseline_sha256": hashlib.sha256(before.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "entries": entries}
(OUT / "core-models-owner-first-verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"fresh_entry_processes": len(entries), "all_metadata_comparisons_passed": True, "mappers_per_entry": entries[0]["mappers"]}))

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND / "scripts"))
from verify_backend_quality_budgets import measure_source

archive = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-original-source.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
old_source = archive["source"]
assert hashlib.sha256(old_source.encode()).hexdigest() == archive["sha256"]
old_tree = ast.parse(old_source)
old_classes = {node.name: node for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)}
owner_map = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-owner-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
facade_path = BACKEND / "app/infrastructure/database/models.py"
facade_tree = ast.parse(facade_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
models = importlib.import_module("app.infrastructure.database.models")
public_module = models.__name__
movements = []
bindings = []
all_moved = []


def value_names(node):
    # Future annotations are resolved through the published module; expression
    # values, bases, defaults and constraint constructors use each owner scope.
    values = list(node.bases)
    for item in node.body:
        if isinstance(item, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) and item.value is not None:
            values.append(item.value)
    return {child.id for value in values for child in ast.walk(value) if isinstance(child, ast.Name) and isinstance(child.ctx, ast.Load)}


for item in owner_map["owners"]:
    path = ROOT / item["path"]
    module_name = item["path"].removeprefix("backend/").removesuffix(".py").replace("/", ".")
    module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    actual_classes = {node.name: node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)}
    assert list(actual_classes) == item["classes"]
    for name in item["classes"]:
        current = copy.deepcopy(actual_classes[name])
        metadata = [node for node in current.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "__module__" for target in node.targets)]
        assert len(metadata) == 1
        assert ast.literal_eval(metadata[0].value) == public_module
        current.body.remove(metadata[0])
        assert ast.dump(current) == ast.dump(old_classes[name]), name
        cls = getattr(module, name)
        assert getattr(models, name) is cls
        assert cls.__module__ == public_module and cls.__qualname__ == name
        assert cls.__table__ is models.Base.metadata.tables[cls.__tablename__]
        assert cls.__mro__[1] is models.Base
        for dependency in sorted(value_names(old_classes[name])):
            if dependency in vars(models):
                assert getattr(module, dependency) is getattr(models, dependency), (name, dependency)
                bindings.append({"class": name, "dependency": dependency, "actual_owner_and_legacy_namespace_object_identical": True})
        movements.append({"class": name, "owner": item["path"], "whole_class_ast_equal_after_only_explicit_legacy_module_assignment": True, "actual_alias_table_registry_base_identity": True})
        all_moved.append(name)
contract = next(node for node in facade_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef))
assert contract.name == "PlatformSettingsValue"
assert ast.dump(contract) == ast.dump(old_classes[contract.name])
assert all_moved == owner_map["declaration_order"]
actual_imports = [alias.name for node in facade_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 1 and node.module.startswith("_core_models.") for alias in node.names]
assert actual_imports == all_moved
old_aliases = [ast.dump(node) for node in old_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)]
new_aliases = [ast.dump(node) for node in facade_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)]
assert new_aliases == old_aliases


def import_bindings(tree):
    result = {}
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                result[alias.asname or alias.name.split(".")[0]] = ("module", alias.name)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and not (node.level == 1 and node.module.startswith("_core_models.")):
            for alias in node.names:
                result[alias.asname or alias.name] = ("from", node.module, alias.name, node.level)
    return result


assert import_bindings(facade_tree) == import_bindings(old_tree)
for path, digest in archive["migrations"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
contexts = json.loads((OUT / "backend-models-preflight-context.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for path in ["backend/app/infrastructure/database/model_base.py", "backend/app/infrastructure/database/model_registry.py"]:
    old_hash = next(row["sha256"] for row in contexts if row["path"] == path)
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == old_hash

runtime_paths = [facade_path, BACKEND / "app/infrastructure/database/_core_models/__init__.py", *[ROOT / item["path"] for item in owner_map["owners"]]]
test_path = BACKEND / "tests/unit/infrastructure/test_core_model_owner_compatibility.py"
new_paths = runtime_paths[1:] + [test_path]
git_query = subprocess.run(["git", "cat-file", "--batch-check=%(objectname)"], input="".join("HEAD:" + str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/") + "\n" for path in new_paths), cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, check=True)
git_results = git_query.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(git_results) == len(new_paths)
assert all(line.endswith(" missing") for line in git_results)
manifest = []
for path in [*runtime_paths, test_path]:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert b"\r" not in raw
    manifest.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "physical_lines": len(raw.decode().splitlines()), "bytes": len(raw), "line_endings": "LF", "git_head_present": path == facade_path, "kind": "runtime" if path in runtime_paths else "test"})
(OUT / "core-models-source-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({"runtime_file_count": len(runtime_paths), "new_runtime_files": 14, "new_test_files": 1, "files": manifest}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

before = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-before-registry-metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
after = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-after-model_registry-metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert after == before
entry_checks = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-owner-first-verification.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert len(entry_checks["entries"]) == 13 and entry_checks["all_13_owner_first_entries_match_public_baseline"]
proof = {"original_source_sha256": archive["sha256"], "whole_class_movements": movements, "mapped_classes_moved": len(movements), "public_typed_contract_ast_exact": True, "original_declaration_registration_order_preserved": True, "all_original_import_bindings_preserved": True, "all_original_external_model_alias_statements_ast_exact": len(old_aliases), "actual_runtime_value_bindings": bindings, "shared_base_and_registry_source_hashes_unchanged": True, "published_migrations_unchanged": len(archive["migrations"]), "actual_full_metadata_comparison": {"tables": len(before["tables"]), "mappers": len(before["mappers"]), "columns": sum(len(table["columns"]) for table in before["tables"].values()), "constraints": sum(len(table["constraints"]) for table in before["tables"].values()), "indexes": sum(len(table["indexes"]) for table in before["tables"].values()), "relationships": sum(len(mapper["relationships"]) for mapper in before["mappers"].values()), "dialects": ["sqlite", "postgresql"], "compile_errors": len(before["compile_errors"]), "actual_ddl_defaults_conditions_module_pickle_hints_and_relationship_snapshots_equal": True}, "fresh_owner_first_entries": 13, "preexisting_annotation_limitations": {name: value["get_type_hints"] for name, value in before["core_classes"].items() if not value["get_type_hints"]["ok"]}, "bound_sources": manifest}
(OUT / "core-models-extraction-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
measurements = [asdict(measure_source(path, str(path.relative_to(BACKEND)).replace("\\", "/"))) for path in runtime_paths]
budgets = json.loads((BACKEND / "backend_quality_budgets.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
previous = {item["path"]: item for item in budgets["modules"]}
critical = {item["path"]: item for item in budgets.get("coverage_gates", {}).get("critical_modules", [])}
candidates = {"shared_gates_edited": False, "measurements": measurements, "previous_budgets": {item["path"]: previous.get(item["path"]) for item in measurements}, "previous_critical_floors": {item["path"]: critical.get(item["path"]) for item in measurements}, "candidates": [{"path": item["path"], "baseline_lines": item["lines"], "maximum_lines": item["lines"], "baseline_max_function_complexity": item["max_function_complexity"], "maximum_function_complexity": item["max_function_complexity"], "minimum_coverage_percent": max(95, previous.get(item["path"], {}).get("minimum_coverage_percent", 0))} for item in measurements], "proposed_critical_floors": [{"path": item["path"], "minimum_line_percent": max(95, critical.get(item["path"], {}).get("minimum_line_percent", 0)), "minimum_branch_percent": max(95, critical.get(item["path"], {}).get("minimum_branch_percent", 0))} for item in measurements], "owner_size_exception": "PassportSubmissionModel remains one complete 287-line declaration. Its focused owner includes necessary imports and a legacy module assignment; no mapping mixin or existing cap/floor was relaxed."}
(OUT / "core-models-budget-candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(candidates, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"whole_mapped_classes": len(movements), "actual_value_bindings": len(bindings), "unchanged_migrations": len(archive["migrations"]), "runtime_files": len(runtime_paths), "measurements": measurements}, indent=2))

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import inspect
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))
OUT = ROOT / "docs/audit/dashboard-2026-10-30"
mapping = json.loads((OUT / "core-models-owner-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
records = []
for row in mapping["owners"]:
    module = importlib.import_module(row["path"].removeprefix("backend/").removesuffix(".py").replace("/", "."))
    assert inspect.getsource(module)
    for name in row["classes"]:
        cls = getattr(module, name)
        try:
            located = {"ok": True, "source": inspect.getsource(cls)}
        except (OSError, TypeError) as exc:
            located = {"ok": False, "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
        records.append({"class": name, "public_module": cls.__module__, "inspect_getfile": str(Path(inspect.getfile(cls)).relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/"), "actual_source_owner": row["path"], "inspect_getsource_class": located, "inspect_getsource_owner_module": "works"})
(OUT / "core-models-source-locations.json").write_text(json.dumps({"observed_developer_source_lookup_limitation": True, "no_runtime_inspect_monkeypatch_or_proxy": True, "records": records}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"mapped_classes": len(records), "class_source_lookup_errors": sum(not row["inspect_getsource_class"]["ok"] for row in records), "owner_module_source_lookup_successes": len(mapping["owners"])}))
